No reply contract for a write was ever written; the one requirement asking for receipts is proposed and unbuilt","source":"art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29","statement":"RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), triage of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item I4, 2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (designer agent, flo2 claude.ai connector, reflow2 0.74.0; friction-log entries #4, #17, #30):
- Revising writes (replace_text, set_decision_status, add_component revise) echo the whole node.
- An append of ~170 chars returned ~7 KB; one of ~900 chars returned ~11 KB.
- About 290 KB was echoed over 3 rounds for about 40 KB of edits.
Expected: a receipt. NOT affected: reads, which are bounded by the reply budget.

② PRECEDENT:
- This requirement (proposed, 2026-09-28) already measured a 1,182-char append returning ~17 KB.
- fact:defect-the-reply-costs-more-than-the-answer-and-amending-prose-costs-the-whole-field (2026-09-04).
- The class note in fact:root-cause-add-decision-discards-the-edge-echo-its-related-to-computed-2026-09-28: "each constructor hand-builds its reply".
No record gave the cause of the whole-node echo itself.

③ CANDIDATES:
(a) Loud on purpose: req:a-revising-write-says-what-it-removed.
(b) Every write handler returns the stored node (ok_json of the NodeDto), so unchanged fields ride along.
(c) flo2's gateway inflates the reply: it wraps it and sends the text block plus structuredContent.
(d) The observation is wrong.

④⑤ MEASURED with the installed 0.74.0 release binary in an isolated scratch graph (`--call`, scratch HOME), with no gateway:
- add_decision with a 6,000-char decision: 6,330-char reply, echoing what was just sent.
- replace_text append of 170 chars to that field: 13,277 chars. That is `node` 6,367 plus `revision` 6,481, and the revision's replaced[0].prior holds the full prior field.
- replace_text append of 12 chars to the node's 1-char RATIONALE: 7,501 chars, because the unchanged 6 KB decision field came back in `node`.
- set_decision_status: 6,414 chars.
- Live, in this triage: a ~720-char append to a 9,219-char finding statement on this design returned the new field (9,936) plus the prior (9,219), about 20 KB.
Reading the results:
- (d) is refuted.
- (c) is not the source: the local binary reproduces with no gateway. It is a multiplier on flo2's wire, which I5 covers in flo2's design.
- (a) explains only revision.prior, which the requirement keeps "on request from the preserved snapshot", and does not explain echoing unchanged fields.
- (b) is confirmed.

⑥ CLASS. No write's reply shape was ever stated as a contract. Each handler returns the stored node by convention, and replace_text adds each prior value. Fixing replace_text alone would not have stopped set_decision_status (6.4 KB to change one status) or add_decision (6.3 KB to echo its own input). The requirement's (a) RECEIPTS is the class fix and is proposed, not built.

⑦⑧ OWED: a pinning test that bounds every write's reply by the size of its change plus a constant, run over all constructors and setters; and the receipt fix itself.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED:
- Whether the model reads both copies on flo2's wire (text plus structuredContent). fact:reflow2-proved-structured-readership-cannot-be-detected-2026-09-21 says no client can be asked.
